_about: Main settings for Goalscraper (data from OpenFootAPI's free plan).

weights._about: form = how much recent games tweak long-term strength (0 to 1).

score_scale._about: Score 100 when P(0-0) is at or below 'p00_at_100', score 1 at or above 'p00_at_1' (log scale in between).

requests._about: OpenFootAPI free plan: 5,000 requests a month. A normal day uses about 10-20; the first run uses more to collect the season so far.
